title: Apartments/Dorms and morphing houses…
content: Last night I dreamt that I was in the tower dorm/hotels, with a lot of bustling activity. A lot of staircase/elevator/auditorium time, until the “bad weather” passed, and then we were being shuttled on the monorail over the angry, black river, to an area with bridges, some restaurants, and a college or university. I was expected to make a class schedule, but I tried to explain that I have a masters already and enough in student loans- like the mallworld and real life had kind of overlapped. Then, I was taken to a newer area (to me), a very stark, bare, “build to suit” entrance to the mall, off on its own (to the left/east) that was reminiscent of shady medical offices, but the helipad airport was above it. Some time after I was back in a college rental house with others, and it was like everyone was moving back into the house in their respective units (a ranch style split-level, yeah, makes no sense) that was weirdly split into multiple, familiar units. There was a slightly fun part, something about a marching band, and then some weird “office job choosing” process, where I was back in “Florida”, and somehow I was being shown a business name and address, which I don’t even know if it exists for real). The name was South Florida Mortgage, which in the address was in West Palm Beach, near Haverhill and Okeechobee Blvd (actual real places). I will have to look it up later, because somehow in the dream it was connected to J Epstein. Now, I will admit, I am a tired new mom, but these dreams are just as vivid awake as they were in the dream. I have also been limiting my news intake, which makes some of this very interesting. Anybody else getting some extra weird activity recently?
